acceptance.criterion_verbatim: S7-AC2 -- JUDGMENT, RECORDED AND NOT SELF-GRADED. State for 3.0.0_SA_CVO: which holdings shapes your synthetic specimens cannot represent (multi-sheet workbooks, merged cells, non-USD), and how a real specimen would change the parser; and where 'programmatic by default, review the exception' could quietly become 'review everything'. acceptance.invocation: judgment -- recorded, not self-graded; the reads behind it are: the five committed specimens and their FIXTURE_MANIFEST.json; the parser's own finding-code table and reconciliation identity; _contracts/AnalysisRequest.schema.json; the battery's per-specimen finding counts; and the IB-s-6 evidence that no real forwarded specimen exists
acceptance.output_evidence: (1) WHAT THE SPECIMENS CANNOT REPRESENT, AND HOW A REAL ONE WOULD CHANGE THE PARSER. The three the criterion names, plus five it does not. (i) MULTI-SHEET WORKBOOKS. read_xlsx reads the FIRST worksheet and REPORTS the rest rather than pretending they are absent: result.workbook carries sheets_in_workbook and sheets_not_read. A real custodian export routinely puts positions on one sheet and a cash/transaction ledger on another, and 'first sheet' would then parse the positions and lose the cash entirely -- silently, because the reconciliation identity is computed PER SHEET READ and would balance perfectly on the sheet it saw. THE FIX IS NOT 'read every sheet': it is to make the CHOICE explicit -- parse each sheet, reconcile each, and refuse when more than one carries an identifier header, because which sheet is 'the holdings' is a question only the specimen's own shape can answer. (ii) MERGED CELLS. openpyxl writes none and my reader ignores the mergeCells part entirely. A merged group label spanning A5:C5 arrives as text in A5 and EMPTY B5/C5, which my group-header heuristic ('one populated cell, no number on the row') happens to classify correctly -- BY LUCK, not by reading the merge. A merged HEADER (a two-row header with 'Market Value' merged over 'USD') would break the header detector outright, and the specimen would be refused rather than misparsed, which is the safe direction but is not the same as handling it. (iii) NON-USD. There is no currency ANYWHERE in the pipeline: the contract's units enum is SHARES / USD / WEIGHT_DECIMAL, and USD is a UNIT, not a currency field. A specimen with a CAD column would parse to units USD and be arithmetically summed with dollar rows -- the single worst failure available here, because it is silent, it is a number, and it is wrong by an exchange rate. A real non-USD specimen does not change the parser; IT CHANGES THE CONTRACT, and that is a PRD-level act, not a cell-level one. (iv) NESTED OR SUBTOTALLED GROUPING. My grouping is flat and a subtotal row that is not labelled 'Total' would parse as a HOLDING and double-count into the computed total; the TOTAL_MISMATCH finding would fire, which is the system noticing, but the finding would name the wrong cause. (v) A HOLDINGS TABLE PASTED INTO THE MAIL BODY with no attachment at all -- the poller persists the body's MIME but nothing here reads it. (vi) itemAttachment / referenceAttachment (a OneDrive link rather than bytes), carried from the IB-s-6 judgment because the parser is downstream of it. (vii) DATES IN A QUANTITY COLUMN: openpyxl and Excel both store dates as serial numbers, so a 'Maturity' column read as a quantity yields 45,678 of something. My units vocabulary does not contain 'maturity', so such a column is not selected -- but only because the vocabulary is a closed list, which is a defence that holds exactly as long as nobody adds a permissive synonym. (viii) NON-ASCII NAMES AND TICKERS. _TICKER_RE is ASCII-only and a non-ASCII identifier lands UNMATCHED -- correct, but a reviewer reading the finding sees the identifier round-tripped through Python's %r, which is a display question this cell did not solve. (2) WHERE 'PROGRAMMATIC BY DEFAULT, REVIEW THE EXCEPTION' COULD QUIETLY BECOME 'REVIEW EVERYTHING'. This is the question I would put highest for the CVO, because the mechanism is already visible in the battery's own numbers and it is not a hypothetical. needs_correction is TRUE when ANY finding has severity UNCERTAIN or BLOCKING, and the finding table assigns UNCERTAIN to FIVE of its seven codes -- UNMATCHED_IDENTIFIER, AMBIGUOUS_IDENTIFIER, SHARE_CLASS_SUBSTITUTION_PROPOSED, UNITS_UNDETERMINED and TOTAL_MISMATCH. MEASURED ON THIS CELL'S OWN SPECIMENS: 2 of 4 enter needs-correction, and the two that do are the two that carry any real-world messiness at all. THREE WAYS THIS BECOMES 'REVIEW EVERYTHING', in increasing order of how quietly it happens. (a) THE SHARE-CLASS PROPOSAL IS THE LOUDEST OFFENDER. It is UNCERTAIN, so a portfolio holding two mutual-fund share classes -- entirely ordinary -- enters review every single time, forever, even when the advisor NEVER wants the substitution. Nothing in this cell records a REJECTION durably; corrections.apply_corrections applies approvals, and a rejected proposal simply comes back on the next submission of the same holding. A standing 'this advisor does not substitute share classes' decision is the missing artifact, and without it the proposal is not an exception, it is a recurring tax. (b) TOTAL_MISMATCH FIRES ON ROUNDING. The comparison is exact (difference != 0 after rounding to 6 places). A custodian export that states a total rounded to the dollar while listing cents will mismatch by pennies on most real files. That single code could put nearly every real specimen into review while being, every time, correct about the arithmetic and useless to the reviewer. A tolerance is the obvious repair and it is NOT in this cell, deliberately -- choosing a tolerance is choosing what difference does not matter, which is a decision about someone's money and not a parser's to make quietly. (c) THE RATIO NOBODY IS WATCHING. There is no measurement anywhere of what fraction of requests enter needs-correction, so the drift from 'the exception' to 'everything' would be invisible until a person said the workflow felt slower. The cheap instrument is a count of requests by stage over a window, and it is not built here because this project builds no monitor without Andrew's word (bound 2) -- so the honest statement is that the DRIFT IS CURRENTLY UNOBSERVABLE BY CONSTRUCTION, and that is a thing the CVO should weigh rather than a gap to fill inside this cell. (3) ONE MORE, UNASKED, BECAUSE IT BEARS ON HOW THE ABOVE IS READ: every number in (2) is measured on FIVE SYNTHETIC SPECIMENS I WROTE, and I chose their messiness. The 2-of-4 needs-correction rate is a property of my fixture set, not of the advisor population. It should be re-measured on the first ten real specimens before any tolerance, severity or suppression is chosen on the strength of it.

determinism.method: Two full runs of the battery on the same inputs, compared LINE BY LINE over the ENTIRE output rather than a chosen subset. Nothing in the output carries a timestamp, an ephemeral port or a random value -- the revision hashes are over canonical JSON of deterministic content and the request ids are literals -- so byte-equality of the whole output is achievable and is the stronger claim available.
